subject: Commit sanity check + strategic top-up plan for Q3 coverage
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit sanity check + strategic top-up plan for Q3 coverage

Team —

Quick callout before the week starts: Finance ran a sensitivity on our Q3 forecast and there’s a ~22% shortfall vs. target once we trim for likely closes (70% confidence buckets). We need a short, prioritized play to shore coverage without creating impossible asks for AEs.

Attached: Q3_coverage_tracker.xlsx (current pipe by stage/account) and a first draft of a "top-up" playbook (topup_playbook_v1.pdf) with recommended motions.

Asks:
- Rishi: can you run a quick filter to identify deals >= $50k that are still in Negotiation/Legal or have exec sponsor outreach open? Prioritize ones with ETR in July/Aug.
- Lauren: please validate which enterprise renewal conversations are in the same quarter and whether we can accelerate closure by offering a 30-day onboarding credit (finance aligned).
- Ben: reach out to Enablement for a short "deal desk" pulse to confirm any product/POC blockers (one-paragraph ask).

I'll consolidate responses into a two-slide summary for Finance and the CFO review on Friday. If you hit blockers or need me to own outreach to specific accounts, flag them here.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_coverage_tracker.xlsx, topup_playbook_v1.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit sanity check + strategic top-up plan for Q3 coverage

Stephanie —

I pulled the filter and attached a short export: Acme, NovaTech, and Meridian are the three deals that meet the >=$50k + Negotiation/Legal criteria with ETR in July/Aug. Quick notes below:

- Acme Analytics (RWD-2478): $120k ARR, in Legal, waiting on final procurement SOW. Sales rep indicates legal redlines are standard — likely close but needs finance signoff for net-30 terms.
- NovaTech: $75k ARR, exec sponsor engaged; PO expected mid-July.
- Meridian Systems: $60k ARR, POC wrap scheduled; product is green but customer needs new SOC evidence (legal hold).

I also flagged 4 mid-market deals (~$20k–$45k) that we could push with a tactical discount/fast-onboarding package; listed in the sheet.

Attaching: Acme_MA_plan_061922.docx (rep's proposed contracting plan).

On product blockers: Ben, I saw the note about Meridian — I'm happy to join the call if it helps move the SOC thread along.

—Rishi

Attachments: Acme_MA_plan_061922.docx

From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics Finance <finance@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit sanity check + strategic top-up plan for Q3 coverage

Thanks for the clear notes, Stephanie. Quick responses from Acme's side: 

- Legal: our procurement lead confirmed the outstanding SOW redline is around data-retention language. We can accept Redwood's standard retention with a short addendum; Finance needs final price and payment term confirmation.
- Timing: we're on track to sign the SOW week of July 9, but procurement asks for a single invoice and net-45 payment — would Redwood accept net-45 in lieu of the onboarding credit?

If net-45 is a problem, we can commit to net-30 with a PO issued by July 3. Either way, we'd like a final price and an explicit list of deliverables attached to the SOW.

Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Jill Turner
VP Finance, Acme Analytics

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit sanity check + strategic top-up plan for Q3 coverage

Thanks, Jill — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Quick plan based on Rishi's filter and your notes:
1) Acme (RWD-2478): Stephanie to own contract finalization. Rishi — please send me the redline summary and the rep proposal now attached; finance will evaluate net-45 vs onboarding credit. If finance pushes back, we'll accept net-30 with PO by July 3 as an alternative.
2) NovaTech & Meridian: Rishi to continue direct cadence; Ben to confirm product evidence for Meridian (SOC artifact ETA Wednesday).
3) Mid-market list: Lauren to reach out tomorrow with the fast-onboarding offer; limit to deals that can turn in 10 business days.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Rishi: deliver redline summary + one-paragraph close plan for Acme — due EOD Monday 6/25.
- Ben: provide SOC artifact ETA for Meridian and note any gating engineering work — due Wed 6/27.
- Lauren: outreach to mid-market cohort and feedback on conversion likelihood — due Tue 6/26.
- Stephanie: consolidate into two slides for CFO; send Finance the recommended path (top-up vs term accommodation) — draft due Thu 6/28.

If anyone can't hit the due date, call it out now so I can reassign. Plan to present the two-slide summary to Finance on Friday 6/29.

Thanks everyone — short, tactical, and focused.

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
